payload.text:
Prove this Lean 4 theorem (source: FATE-M, difficulty: easy).

Informal statement:
For every positive integer n at least two, the ring of integers modulo n is a field if and only if n is prime.

Formal statement to prove:
theorem fatem_019_zmod_isField_iff_prime (n : ℕ) :
    IsField (ZMod n) ↔ Nat.Prime n

Each role chooses its next allowed action. Use search_lemmas and compiler tools when they resolve real uncertainty. Hand off only when the receiving role can act on concrete mathematical, compiler, or review evidence. A non-linear route is allowed, but extra communication is not itself success. The final proof must compile, preserve the exact statement, and contain no sorry, admit, or added axiom.

tool_calls.arguments:
{"code":"import Mathlib

 theorem fatem_019_zmod_isField_iff_prime (n : ℕ) :
    IsField (ZMod n) ↔ Nat.Prime n := by
  constructor
  · intro hF
    by_contra hnp
    have h2 : 2 ≤ n := by
      by_contra hlt
      have hnle : n ≤ 1 := Nat.not_lt.mp hlt
      have hzero : (0 : ZMod n) = 1 := by
        cases n with
        | zero => simp
        | succ m =>
            cases m with
            | zero => simp at hnle
            | succ k => omega
      have hneq : (0 : ZMod n) ≠ 1 := zero_ne_one
      exact hneq hzero
    rcases (Nat.not_prime_iff_exists_mul_eq h2).mp hnp with ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab⟩
    have hz : ((a : ZMod n) * (b : ZMod n)) = 0 := by
      rw [← Nat.cast_mul, hab]
      exact ZMod.natCast_self n
    have hfa : (a : ZMod n) = 0 ∨ (b : ZMod n) = 0 := by
      haveI := hF.toField
      exact eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero hz
    cases hfa with
    | inl hza =>
        have hdiv : n ∣ a := (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff a n).mp hza
        rcases hdiv with ⟨k, hk⟩
        have : n ≤ a := by
          rw [hk]
          exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by
            intro hk0
            simp [hk0] at ha))
        exact Nat.not_le_of_lt ha this
    | inr hzb =>
        have hdiv : n ∣ b := (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff b n).mp hzb
        rcases hdiv with ⟨k, hk⟩
        have : n ≤ b := by
          rw [hk]
          exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by
            intro hk0
            simp [hk0] at hb))
        exact Nat.not_le_of_lt hb this
  · intro hp
    letI : Fact (Nat.Prime n) := ⟨hp⟩
    infer_instance
"}

{"code":"import Mathlib

 theorem fatem_019_zmod_isField_iff_prime (n : ℕ) :
    IsField (ZMod n) ↔ Nat.Prime n := by
  constructor
  · intro hF
    by_contra hnp
    have h1n : n ≠ 1 := by
      intro h1
      have h01 : (1 : ZMod n) = 0 := by simpa [h1] using (ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff : (1 : ZMod n) = 0 ↔ n = 1).2 h1
      have h10 : (0 : ZMod n) = 1 := h01.symm
      exact zero_ne_one h10
    have h2 : 2 ≤ n := by omega
    rcases (Nat.not_prime_iff_exists_mul_eq h2).mp hnp with ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab⟩
    have hz : ((a : ZMod n) * (b : ZMod n)) = 0 := by
      rw [← Nat.cast_mul, hab]
      exact ZMod.natCast_self n
    haveI : IsDomain (ZMod n) := hF.isDomain
    have hfa : (a : ZMod n) = 0 ∨ (b : ZMod n) = 0 := by
      exact eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero hz
    cases hfa with
    | inl hza =>
        have hdiv : n ∣ a := (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff a n).mp hza
        have : ¬ n ∣ a := by
          intro hdiv
          rcases hdiv with ⟨k, hk⟩
          cases k with
          | zero => simp [hk] at ha
          | succ k =>
              have hnle : n ≤ a := by rw [hk]; exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (Nat.succ_pos _)
              exact Nat.not_le_of_lt ha hnle
        exact this hdiv
    | inr hzb =>
        have hdiv : n ∣ b := (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff b n).mp hzb
        have : ¬ n ∣ b := by
          intro hdiv
          rcases hdiv with ⟨k, hk⟩
          cases k with
          | zero => simp [hk] at hb
          | succ k =>
              have hnle : n ≤ b := by rw [hk]; exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (Nat.succ_pos _)
              exact Nat.not_le_of_lt hb hnle
        exact this hdiv
  · intro hp
    let _ : Fact (Nat.Prime n) := ⟨hp⟩
    exact Field.toIsField (ZMod n)
"}
